entities.name: Borka Pavićević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Borka Pavićević was a Montenegrin born Serbian dramaturge, columnist, and cultural activist. She was also described as a "dramatist, Belgrade liberal and pacifist intellectual". She founded the Centre for Cultural Decontamination in 1994, and was a co-founder of the Belgrade Circle.
